Auto.CliHelp:
sr "RULE NAME OR ID"
Run a rule in an existing SonicRoute instance from any directory. Quote names containing spaces.
sr --legacy "RULE NAME": target Legacy; Lite is preferred when both editions are running.
Reopen your terminal after the first launch of this build. Fails if the app is not running; never launches it.

SonicRoute.exe --run-rule "RULE NAME OR ID"
Runs a saved rule directly, including rules with automatic triggering disabled; preserves step order and delays.
Uses a running instance; otherwise executes temporarily and exits. Output: one JSON line.
Exit codes: 0=ok, 1=step failed, 2=invalid arguments, 3=not found, 4=duplicate name or ID, 5=busy, 6=server unavailable, 7=canceled, 8=internal error.
